mapper.insert: INSERT INTO likes (user_id, post_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, post_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM likes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT post_id AS postId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM likes WHERE post_id IN #{id} GROUP BY post_id
SELECT post_id FROM likes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id IN #{id}
